Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

1479-2374-2841-8102.easyPrerequisites:

There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.

Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-6528-8099.easyPrerequisites:

Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Repeat.

3899-4435-4550-5567--112.description:

Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4716-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1409-3099-3499-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.

Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.

Repeat.

1303-1769-2511.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1115-3259-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
1115-3259-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1115-3259-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

2103-2963-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Teleportation Circle.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

3188-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2308-2741-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-2741-4050-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Essence Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Bloodbond Vampire by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Bloodbond Vampire triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3698-3908-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
3698-3908-5365.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Spark Double's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spark Double.
Spark Double's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

An opponent controls a creature.

Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.

428-1694-3174-5361.description:

Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

Repeat.

Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Romana II.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Idris ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
